description: The story viewer state machine: navigation, timing, pausing, viewability and the analytics events each step produces. Events per step: action events (tap_forward, tap_back, group_skip, exit) first, then transition events (group_complete, group_open, story_view).

cases.name: opens at the first story of a group, buffering, and reports group_open
an image counts as viewed after 1 s on screen, then advances when it ends
the timer doesn't run until the media is ready
tapping forward and back moves between stories
tapping forward on a group's last story completes it and opens the next group
a group isn't completed if its last story never displayed
back from a group's first story lands on the previous group's last story
back on the very first story restarts it
skipping to the next and previous group
closing reports exit and closes with reason user
finishing the last story of the last group closes with reason completed
a video ending by itself moves on without tap_forward
a video needs 2 s of continuous playback; pausing and buffering restart the count
an image held paused still counts as on screen, but its timer stops
going off screen restarts the viewability count
media that fails to load is never viewed, but the viewer still moves on
a loaded video's real duration replaces the feed's
a story that qualifies as it ends counts before moving on
non-positive ticks change nothing
entering a group starts at its first unseen story
an out-of-range start story falls back to the first
a group without stories doesn't open
a tick that makes a story viewed reports it first and advances on the next tick
